reviews.comment: AWESOME CLASS! Would take this 20x over if I could, can't recommend her enough. Like anything at A&M, it requires buy-in but once you do it truly is a transforming class.

Whether you want to reduce anxiety or dive deeper into spirituality, she'll meet you wherever you're at. I joined this class extremely lost in life, and she has fostered immense growth in me. You're only requirement is to show up for yourself in ways that are often overlooked. Easiest (technically) class yet, the most rewarding. A MUST TAKE CLASS!

Truly wanted to connect with her students on a deeper level. Meditation of Leaders was an awesome way to get a break throughout an otherwise busy semester. Will definitely be a little bit different of an experience then what you're used to.

Mrs. Templin is a caring and empathetic teacher. I took Meditation for Leaders and expect LOTS of movement meditation. Almost half of the class is standing meditation and lots of breathing exercises. There are many writing assignments but they're short and free drabble so you can get it wrong. Overall, a pleasant experience and somwhat relaxing!

Mrs. Templin is a passionate and caring professor. She cares deeply about her student's health and their journeys. I have taken her class three times now and have learned so much about myself in the process. If you have the opportunity to take this class- Please do! It has been one of the most influential/best decisions I have made during college.
easy class and interesting

This was seriously my most worthwhile class I've ever taken at A&M altogether. Prof. Templin is very wise, and has tons of useful insight to share with her students which she has gained through her own experiences. Her words are clearly backed by personal mastery, and we as students can just feel that presence about her which is simply admirable.

Mrs. Templin is phenomenal. This class truly teaches you tools to manage anxiety and stress, and even more emotions life causes. She has truly changed my life. I've retaken this class three times just because of how much it helps me. Templin truly cares about her students and wants everyone to just be happy. Highly recommend

Professor Templin is absolutely wonderful. She held space for open communication and was incredibly helpful when we met outside of class. She helped me to shift my perspective and find peace regardless of the situation at hand. I am forever grateful for the wisdom and kindness she shared with us. Highly recommend taking this class!

This class was exactly what I needed in my life because I was living in my mind, not my heart. I learned how to meditate and it was easier than I ever imagined. She does a great job at breaking down the basics and essentials of meditation. Relaxing the body, calming the mind, and opening the heart. It's meditation through empowering movements.

This was the greatest class I have ever taken in my life, it should be a requirement for all students. I have never felt more seen or heard before Mrs. Templin. I learned how to connect and listen to my body, become comfortable with self-expression, and found my true and authentic self. It teaches people how to find mindfulness in a busy world.

Mrs. Templin is not only the greatest teacher I've had at A&M, but in my life. Her class taught me accessible and needed tools to navigate life stresses with flow and ease. She is deeply understanding and an active listener. I now have a new foundation on how to approach life and have found true clarity and self-awareness. I highly recommend her.

If you are just looking for an easy A, go ahead. Personally, I did not get much out of the class other than a decent break from studying. Others swear by meditation, so that's really subjective. My annoyance was her ultimately not abiding by her own syllabus and giving her (non-expert) two-cents on prescribed medications for mental health. :/ Eh.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I LOVED this class. I think every student should take a meditation course because it helped me so much this semester. Prof Templin creates a judgment-free zone for you to really relax and enjoy some quiet. We only had one quiz and it was probably the easiest thing I've done in cstat.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't know if I could've hated this class more. It's "meditation for stress and anxiety", but when talking about struggles she literally said, "get over it". I didn't feel relaxed once in this class because we never meditated. She forced us to wiggle around on our own while she sat on her phone or judged us. Brought a really bad energy to class.

This is one of my favorite classes this semester. It's not exactly the meditation I was expecting but she's very inspirational and really cares about her students. I've learned a lot of good life tools and it's a nice getaway from other stressful classes. If I could take this class again I would!!

*Warning!* This is NOT a meditation class, this is tai chi. If you're looking for a place to relax, take deep breaths, and have a pleasant teacher, do not take this class. We stand and do mandatory movements the entire time. We have never once meditated in this class. She doesn't care that most of her students don't find it relaxing.

Glad others felt good in this class, but I honestly don't know why. She had 15 students in our class and didn't once try to learn any of our names all semester. She would call students out in front of everyone, especially if you were on zoom. Every class she would shame the students who chose zoom and always pulled her mask down when she talked

She doesn't care about her students and only teaches meditation in one very specific way, which doesn't work for a lot of people. I would leave class way more agitated than when I came in. Got reported by a student for not wearing a mask, then threw a 10-minute fit in front of everyone because she was so mad she had to wear one (and still refused).

Ms. Templin is the best teacher I've ever had. She is so kind, understanding, and willing to listen to you talk about your problems. You can tell she's a genuine person. Her meditation class completely changed my life, as I was suffering with a handful mental illnesses that exercise and meds wouldn't touch. I highly recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: She's one of the most influential teachers I've ever had. She really makes an effort to show that she cares about you and your experiences. She's kind and understanding if you're struggling with an assignment / anything in general. Classes are mandatory but so so beneficial if you show up and participate. You really can get a lot out of her classes

I took her for her meditation for stress and anxiety. She is super nice and makes some jokes throughout class sometimes. the class may start out a little awkward, but as the semester continues you and your classmates will get to know each other and become great friends. I highly recommend taking this class with her!

I initially took her stress and meditation class for an extra credit hour and ended up really enjoying her advice and learning to meditate. She is very understanding and kind and is a former Aggie! She truly wants the best for her students.

Took her Qi-gong Mediation class last semester and it completely changed how I view myself and the world. Professor Templin is so passionate about the health and quality of life of her students. She has more assignments than most KINE-199 classes, but they are there for you to reflect and get off of your laptop and reconnect with nature!
